DISPLAY_MODE_NAME.description: Selected physical output profile, recorded in benchmark reports.

DISPLAY_INTERLACED.description: Select NTSC interlaced output when one; otherwise use 480p progressive output.

DISPLAY_WIDTH.description: Framebuffer width in pixels, shared by the application and launcher.

DISPLAY_HEIGHT.description: Full framebuffer height in pixels, including both fields for interlaced output.

DISPLAY_REFRESH_NUMERATOR.description: Numerator of the refresh rate in Hz: complete progressive scans or interlaced fields per second.

DISPLAY_REFRESH_DENOMINATOR.description: Denominator of the refresh rate in Hz; nominal 30 FPS presents every second refresh.
